name: Unity Productions Foundation
mission: The mission of Unity Productions Foundation (UPF) is to create peace through the media. UPF produces documentary films for television broadcast, online viewing, and theatrical release and creates long-term educational campaigns to start dialogues among people of different faiths and cultures, especially among Muslims and other faiths.

rich_narrative.summary: Unity Productions Foundation (UPF) is a media-focused nonprofit that uses film and educational outreach to <cite id="1">counter bigotry and stereotypical depictions of Muslims</cite> in American society. Since its <cite id="2">founding in 1999</cite>, the organization has produced high-quality documentaries and media resources to foster social peace. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="3">total revenue of $3,774,653</cite>, representing a significant <cite id="4">three-year revenue growth rate of 27.5%</cite>. This financial expansion supports its diverse programming, including the <cite id="5">MOST (Muslims on Screen and Television) Resource Center</cite> and various film production projects. UPF operates with a <cite id="6">program expense ratio of 76.1%</cite>, which exceeds the 75% industry benchmark for efficiency. The organization maintains <cite id="7">13.1 months of working capital</cite>, providing a strong safety net for long-term media projects. While its work in advocacy and capacity building is specialized, it has achieved significant recognition, including an <cite id="8">Emmy Award nomination for The Sultan and The Saint</cite>. UPF also extends its impact through <cite id="9">educational workshops for teachers</cite> and curriculum development that aligns with <cite id="10">Common Core State Standards</cite>.
